faq.a: These starting prices cover the listed scope. Additional pages, deliverables, complex features, or extra revisions are quoted separately and agreed before work.

Proposed project terms: 50% to book and 50% before final handover. Larger scopes can use agreed milestones. Monthly creative support is paid at the start of each month. Your proposal sets the final terms.

faq.q: What is separate from website pricing?
faq.a: Domain registration, hosting, paid plugins, platform subscriptions, stock assets, copywriting, and ongoing maintenance are separate unless your proposal includes them. E-commerce and custom apps require a tailored quote.

faq.q: What do I need to provide?
faq.a: Your goals, feedback, and approved website text and imagery. Website-only packages assume you already have a usable brand identity. Content support can be added to your quote.

faq.q: Can you work with my budget?
faq.a: Yes—share your priorities and budget range. We can discuss a smaller first phase or a tailored scope. Delivery estimates start after the deposit, content, and required access are received.

faq.q: Are stationery and logo animation included?
faq.a: Brand Essentials includes one double-sided business card layout. Brand Identity adds one letterhead and one editable invoice template. Brand Signature includes those items, one envelope layout, an email signature design, and one simple 3–5 second logo animation in MP4 format, with one motion revision. The animation uses your approved logo; character animation, 3D, voiceover, and custom sound design are quoted separately.

faq.q: What about ID cards, printing, and extra formats?
faq.a: Staff ID card templates, additional stationery, and extra animation formats can be added by quotation. Stationery includes one agreed size and layout per item, print-ready PDF files, and editable source files where applicable. Invoice templates are supplied in one agreed editable format; they do not include accounting software setup. Printing, physical production, staff-by-staff personalisation, and paid font licences are separate. Final deliverables and usage rights are confirmed in your proposal.
Yes. If you already have a developer, ask for a UX/UI-only scope. The listed website packages include design and build; standalone design is quoted around your requirements.
